arguments.command:
cd /tmp/san && export ASAN_OPTIONS=detect_leaks=1:abort_on_error=0 UBSAN_OPTIONS=print_stacktrace=1:halt_on_error=1 && \
./planb64_san build /work/examples/fib.txt /tmp/san/e.idx && cmp /tmp/san/e.idx /work/examples/expected.idx && echo "SAN BUILD OK" && \
./planb64_san lookup /tmp/san/e.idx /work/examples/trace.txt scalar | diff - /work/examples/expected.txt && echo "SAN LOOKUP OK" && \
./planb64_san lookup /tmp/san/e.idx /work/examples/trace.txt batch 3 | diff - /work/examples/expected.txt && echo "SAN BATCH OK"

cd /tmp/san && export ASAN_OPTIONS=detect_leaks=1 UBSAN_OPTIONS=print_stacktrace=1:halt_on_error=1 && \
for f in /tmp/t2/run.sh /tmp/t2/img.sh; do echo "== $f"; done; \
# run the sanitizer binary over the edge-case suite by shadowing BIN
sed 's|BIN=/work/submit/planb64|BIN=/tmp/san/planb64_san|' /tmp/t2/run.sh > /tmp/san/run.sh && sed 's|BIN=/work/submit/planb64|BIN=/tmp/san/planb64_san|' /tmp/t2/img.sh > /tmp/san/img.sh && bash /tmp/san/run.sh 2>&1 | tail -20
